title: LIVE LONG BY FAITH
hookText: The secret to a long life is repeated 4 times in the Bible
openLoop: Coming up: why faith is a marathon, not a sprint

outro.next: No Spectator Seasons — Every Season Has an Assignment

recap.title: The just shall live by faith
items: No one lives long and productive without walking by faith
Faith believes before it sees the results
God shows the next step, not the whole staircase
Faith is the ability to plod on, day after day
God builds you for the load, not the applause
